items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: But I know Chu talked him into swapping arrangements with Chick Webb.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, I talked to him. I made Benny Carter bring arrangements up there and just let us hear it. Then maybe Chu and you talked him into paying...
Not me. But I know Chu talked him into swapping arrangements with Chick Webb.
